title: Cranberry Juice in the Prevention of Urinary Tract Infections in Children
brief_summary: The objective of the study is to determine whether recurrences of urinary tract infection in children can be prevented with cranberry juice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Urinary Tract Infection 0-2 months priorly

Exclusion Criteria:

* Antibiotic Prophylaxis
